question: Which of the following is the nodal ministry for implementation of the ‘SVAMITVA’ scheme launched in 2020?

options.text: Ministry of Urban and Rural Development
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Panchayati Raj.**__

 
• The Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR) is the Nodal Ministry for implementation of the **‘SVAMITVA’** scheme.

 
• Under the SVAMITVA scheme, the rural people are empowered to use the property as a financial asset. 
 
• SVAMITVA stands for Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas.
 
• The physical copies of property titles will be handed over to over 132,000 landowners during the event.
